title: The Turning Wheel Primer
summary: A first primer on qi that returns to its start: arcs that come back to the hand rings that bind and a breath that restores tired limbs.

title: A Handbook of Returning Breath
summary: A handbook on drawing spent qi back in with each breath so that a student renews strength quickly and a guard renews itself.
